summary: Cashless treatment during golden hour for road accident victims; statutory obligation under MV Act, 1988 s.162; scheme not framed by Central Government despite enactment; Motor Vehicle Accident Fund created under s.164-B; failure to implement scheme violates Article 21; direction to frame scheme by 14th March 2025; scheme must ensure prompt, adequate medical care without payment delay; concept note inadequate; life-saving measure mandated.
legal_provisions_cited: Central Motor Vehicles (Motor Vehicle Accident Fund) Rules, 2022
final_judgment: Central Government directed to frame and file scheme under Section 162(2) of MV Act by 14th March 2025; copy of scheme to be placed on record with affidavit by 21st March 2025; no further extension granted.
